reviews.text: If you are ever looking for someone to do your floors I would highly recommend them. They were very professional they educated me about my house and how the process will go replacing the floors. They made it easy for me stress free Gabe & Molly are super knowledgeable and great people to be around. Highly recommended them and they were fast on their quotes.

If I could give 10 stars out of 5 I would. Gabriel and Molly were great and very communicative throughout the entire process. It was evident very early on the integrity that Gabriel has and the pride he takes in his work. He takes his time and he does it right. He's not satisfied unless it is done right and is an extremely honest person. We had a nightmare experience with a contractor before him so him and Molly were a breath of fresh air. We had Kurtz redo our bathroom floor and tub/shower surround with porcelain tile and it came out beautiful. He also fixed a bad flooring job (done by me) around our fireplace. Kurtz will absolute be our first call for any future flooring needs and I know there will be some. Please save yourself from searching for someone to do you flooring and use Kurtz. Highly recommended!!
